Great! I found your account, Noah. I can see you have three orders: #W1845024, #W7043598, and #W6111398.

Let me check the details of your recent orders to help you with canceling or returning items. Which order contains the office supplies and hiking gear you mentioned?

太好了！我找到了您的账户，Noah。我能看到您有三个订单：#W1845024、#W7043598 和 #W6111398。

让我检查您最近订单的详细信息，以帮助您取消或退货。您提到的办公用品和徒步装备在哪个订单中？
